en:
...They would take whatever steps
necessary to stop us.

If we take even a single misstep, the whole
of the underworld could be dragged into war.

Chairman Kurusu. If there's such great risk,
why are you still intent on this alliance?
We can't talk t'ya about that yet.

If y'wanna know so bad, yer gonna hav'ta
promise to be our witness, Kiryu-san.

The current leaders of the Omi Alliance have
great respect for you, a legendary yakuza.

If this pact of ours were to have
your stamp of approval on it...
...The Omi Alliance would begrudgingly accept.

The Dragon of Dojima name still carries
a great deal of weight. I have faith in that.
All right. I understand the situation.
Then, your answer?
I'll pass.
Do you care to explain why?

The sixth chairman of the Tojo Clan,
Daigo Dojima, is currently in jail.

Sugai has taken the role in his absence,
but it's only temporary.

I'm sure it's clear now, but if I agreed to this
pact without consulting the sixth chairman...

It would be nothing short of
treason against the Tojo Clan.
Very well. That is a logical argument.

However, with your refusal, we are bound
to abandon our agreement with Someya-san.

And it's not unlikely that we would seek
a similar deal with the Omi Alliance instead.

Would you be able to accept
that outcome, Fourth Chairman?

I couldn't care less who you ally with or don't.
I left the Tojo Clan behind.
That's a strange response.

If you truly aren't with the Tojo, how
would this be considered a betrayal?
Do you see?
Enough, Tsuneo.

Kiryu-san has already given us his answer.
Let's not prolong the conversation.
My apologies, Chairman.

Pardon me for approaching you about this
matter in such an inelegant way.

The older you get, the more you just
want to see things get done.
It's fine.
Now then, shall we continue our meal?

Yeah. Um, I think there's a good chance
that Tatsukawa-kun is Haruto-kun's father.

A childhood friend o' mine. We swore
our oaths to Hirose-san together.
He's part of the Hirose Family, then?

Well, not exactly.
T'be honest, he left a ways back.

Kiyomi-san.
Why d'ya think it's Tatsukawa?

Something happened just before
Haruka-chan left town.

I overheard Tatsukawa-kun talking on
the phone to someone outside my bar.

He said that having the baby wasn't going
to make anyone happy. To get rid of it.
Get rid of it? Like, an abortion?
That's probably what he meant.

Hold up. How do y'know that Haruka-chan
was the one on the other end o' the line?

Well back then, it wasn't very clear
who Tatsukawa-kun was talking to.

I could tell it was a sad situation,
but I didn't want to butt in.

But now that Haruka-chan disappeared
and had Haruto-kun, it all makes sense.
Where is this Tatsukawa guy now?

Before he left the family, he said
he was gonna make it big up in Tokyo.
Hm? As a musician or something?
Well, I dunno about that.

Pretty sure he jus' thought going to Tokyo
would make him rich one way or another.
Oh, Tatsukawa's a host in Kamurocho now.
A host!?

Tagashira! How'd y'get yer hands
on that kinda info?
Well, we've been keepin' in touch.

He's kept me in the loop
ever since he moved to Tokyo.

Huh? And he chose t'talk to you?
Why didn't he message me?
I don't get it.
Tagashira. Can you still reach him?

Uh, I dunno 'bout that. I haven't heard from
him in ages, and he ain't readin' my messages.
He probly got a new phone or somethin'.

Sorry we don't have anything
more concrete for you.
No, even this clue is a huge step forward.

Haruto, hang in there.
It won't be much longer now.
Kiryu-aniki. Here's a picture o' Tatsukawa.
Haruka chose <font_kind=yakuza_italic>this </font_kind>guy?

It's tough fer me to stomach, too...
but I trust Kiyomi-san's gut on this.

I don't get it. Why would Haruka-chan
go for someone like Tatsukawa?
I wonder if he's really Haruto's dad.

Either way, I don't think I can change
Haruto's diapers anymore. It'd feel wrong.

N' why's that? Him bein' the dad don't
change that it's still Haruka-chan's kid!

If y'really think we need to pitch in so bad,
you can change 'em now, Tagashira.
Why do I gotta do it!?

Haruka-chan was like an angel t'us,
and y'can't deny that Haruto's her kid.

All the same, what Yuta's sayin'
does make some sense.
Right!?

Quit it, y'little shits. There ain't
always logic t'relationships.
Right, Kiyo-chan?
Pardon the intrusion, Fourth Chairman.

Y-You? What're y'doin' here, y'bastard!?
I'm gonna smash yer face in!
Nagumo-kun, don't!
But, Kiyo-chan...
Kiyomi. Can we speak in private?
You can talk to me right here.

I'm done hiding things from Kiryu-san
and the others. It only causes trouble.
From the fourth chairman?

Fine then. I just came to apologize to
you before I headed back to Tokyo.
I'm sorry for interrupting your life here.
That's all I have to say.
Hey, um... How is our little girl?

She's doing well.
She looks more like you every day.
Come back if you want to see her.
Sh-She's got a kid, too...?

I know it's too late for this, but I'm sorry
I didn't tell you about Haruka-chan sooner.
I'm sure you can hardly trust me now.

No, you don't have to apologize to me.
You took care of Haruka, didn't you?
If anything, I should be thanking you.

That reminds me, Kiryu-aniki.
What's Haruka-chan up to now?
Why isn't she here with you and Haruto?
Yeah, huh.

We had t'pretend like we didn't know her
before, so we couldn't ask ya anythin'.

Why y'so quiet, Kiryu-aniki?
Haruka-chan's okay, ain't she?

The truth is, she was in a hit-and-run in
Kamurocho. They still don't know who did it.

It was only a few days ago. She's alive,
but in no condition to talk right now.

Not even the doctors are sure
when she'll regain consciousness.

She was carrying Haruto in
her arms when the car hit her.

Even I didn't know she had a kid until
I went to go see her at the hospital.

There's still so much I don't know,
but... one thing has always stood out.

When Haruka got into that accident,
why exactly was she in Kamurocho?

Three years ago, she left Okinawa and
came here. I know that for certain.

Her disappearing from here is where
it starts getting muddy.

Why did she feel the need to go
all the way to Kamurocho of all places?

If I had t'guess, I'd say she probly
wanted t'go meet up with Tatsukawa.

Now that y'mention it, Tatsukawa left
pretty soon after Haruka-chan disappeared.

Then y'think we'll learn
the truth if we jus' ask Tatsukawa?

Tatsukawa... He's in Kamurocho
working as a host, right?

That's all I need to know
to pick up his trail.

Kiryu-aniki. Yer really gonna
go back to Kamurocho?

Yeah. But right now, Kamurocho is caught in
a war between the Tojo Clan and the Saio Triad.

It's too dangerous for
Haruto to come with me.

Sorry to ask you this, Mama...
but can you watch Haruto for me?
Huh? Me? You're sure?

Of course. There's nobody I'd trust
more to handle Haruto in my place.
Here you go, Haruto.

I'm heading to Kamurocho tomorrow, but I'll
be back as soon as I can. With Tatsukawa.

That bastard Tatsukawa.
I'll never let him live this down.
When we find him, I'll break his legs.

All right, time t'start gettin' ready
fer our trip tomorrow.

Aniki! Yer gonna show us how to
have fun in Kamurocho, yeah!?

Kiryu-aniki. Take care o' Cap
while yer up there.

Temper like his, he could get himself
in real hot water in the big city.

Damn you, Tatsukawa.
He ain't readin' any o' my messages.
I hope y'find 'im in Kamurocho.

Kiryu-aniki. We'll stop by your apartment
tomorrow when we're ready to go.
We can head up to Kamurocho together.
Okay, see you then.

(Better make sure I'm good to go here,
then I'll head back to the apartment.)

(I'm heading to Kamurocho tomorrow.
Should I go to sleep now?)
(I should get to bed.)
(I want to be well-rested for this.)
(It's too early to go to bed.)
(We should head over to Café Alps.)

Hey, Yuta!
That chick is stacked!

She's super hot, yeah? Y'ever even
seen a woman like that back home!?
Cap, you're starin' like a creep!

I guess bein' in the city
really is different, huh...

Crazy how many city slickers are
just walkin' 'round here, yeah?

Any city's gonna be crowded
like this, Cap.

I've been thinkin' though...
What're they all doin' anyway?
These streets're full o' all sortsa shops.
Some mighty fine-lookin' food, too.
I'm getting hungry just thinking about it.

How's it goin', ladies? Y'feelin' up fer
a little fun with me n' my buds here?
Just another jerk. Come on.
W-Wait up! Y'don't gotta go!
This guy...

What the shit!? Tokyo people're
jus' as cold as everyone says.
Nah, I think it's just you, Cap.

Hey, check it out!
How lame are those hicks?
Looks like some farmers playin' dress-up!
Y'wanna fight, buttheads!?
Cap, don't let 'em bother you.

We run this town, you piece of shit.
Who do you think you are?

We're the infamous Hirose Family.
Respect us or I'll rip ya a new one!

Cap, can we please just go already?
We don't have time for this!

I ain't gonna forget the two o' ya.
Y'better not mess with us again!
Go back to your ranch, farm boy!
Aniki. Where's this Café Alps at anyways?
Where's the café?
We're almost there.
This is the place.

Aniki.
Ain't this place kinda pricey?
One damn cup o' coffee is 1,000 yen.

That's before tax.
Cap, can we afford this?

I'm gonna be outta cash in
jus' three days at this rate.

I guess the hookers are gonna
have t'wait then, huh?

Shut it, ass! Y'can't talk about
that stuff in front o' Aniki!

That reminds me, Kiryu-aniki.
Can I use your phone for a second?
I'll give it back in a sec.

Hey, Yuta! What the hell're y'doin'?
Yer overpriced parfait's gonna melt.

Just give me a minute.
Oh, I found it!
This is Tatsukawa's profile.
Tagashira told me where I can find it.
Looks like he's enjoying himself.

What a piece o' shit, doin' that
stuff after Haruka-san's accident!

Why would she ever fall
fer a twinkleshit like that?
When is this picture from?

Looking at the comments,
about two weeks ago.

Pretty recent, then. Y'think it got
took somewhere in Kamurocho?

What do ya think? Does it look
familiar to you, Kiryu-aniki?

Not at all. I spent a long time
in prison, remember?
This city changes a lot in three years.

Great idea, Yuta.
Y'really helped us out there.
Y'don't gotta be an ass about it, Cap.

All right, Aniki.
Whaddya wanna do now?

Y'think we should hit up some host clubs
n' start lookin' fer Tatsukawa?
No, I've got an old haunt I want to start with.

It's a club called Stardust over on Tenkaichi
Street. The owner should be able to help us.
Let's head there first.
Stardust?
It's the number one host club in town.

If Tatsukawa's really working as a host,
somebody there will know him.

Aniki. Can y'hold up a sec?
Yuta's not lookin' so hot.

S-Sorry 'bout this! I'm gonna
head t'the Poppo real quick!

Guess that parfait bit 'im in the ass. That's
what he gets fer eatin' the whole damn thing.
I take it he went to use the bathroom, then.

Probly. Let's get goin', too.
We can wait fer 'im inside.

C'mon, I'm beggin' you!
I'm gonna explode!
I'm sorry, but we don't have a restroom.

Don't lie t'me! What happens when
the employees gotta take a dump!?

I'm sorry, sir, but we can't let customers
back there for inventory control reasons.

So I gotta take a shit right
here on the floor, then!?

Actually, I'm going to have to ask
you to do that outside.
Jus' lemme use it already, asshole!

Kiryu-aniki. Y'don't gotta worry 'bout him.
Let's jus' sit back n' laugh fer a bit.
You make a considerate captain, Nagumo.

Fer real though, convenience stores in Tokyo
don't even let y'shit in 'em? That's harsh.
A-Aniki! Y'should probly take a look at this.

It says the Tojo Clan sixth chairman's
gonna be goin' t'prison soon.

So they dismissed his appeal... All the effort
he put into the trial was for nothing, then.

What're y'gonna do?
Ain't he one o' yer buddies, Aniki?

Nothing I <font_kind=yakuza_italic>can</font_kind> do.
I parted ways with the Tojo Clan.

But if the head o' the clan's behind bars,
ain't that gonna give Someya more power?

Think 'bout it, Aniki. He might come
try n' take Kiyo-chan again.

Maybe you're right, but I'm in no position
to butt into Tojo Clan business anymore.

Please just get out of here!
I'll call the cops!

D-Dammit...! Fine, I'm done with ya!
I'll go somewhere else!

Kiryu-aniki, I'm begging ya.
I-I need a toilet <font_kind=yakuza_italic>now</font_kind>.

Right. Stardust is just over there.
They'll let you use their bathroom.

Wait, what?
Why didn't you say so!?
